text: Select: assay.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target.target_type, target.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value. Source: activities AS act, assays AS assay, target_dictionary AS target, molecule_dictionary AS md, compound_structures AS cs. Join: act.assay_id = assay.assay_id AND assay.tid = target.tid AND act.molregno = md.molregno AND md.molregno = cs.molregno. Filter: target.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741208' AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Sort: md.chembl_id ASC, assay.chembl_id ASC. Limit: 1000.
